privacy_intro: This notice explains how Akademi Quran Raudhatul Jannah (AQRJ) collects and uses personal data in this app, in line with the Personal Data Protection Act 2010.
privacy_what_body: Account name and email; a learner's display name, year of birth and gender if given; learning progress; and recitation recordings submitted for tasmik.
privacy_why_body: To deliver lessons, let teachers give feedback, manage fees, and contact you about your account.
privacy_children_body: A profile for a learner under 18 must be registered by a parent or guardian, who consents on the learner's behalf.
privacy_storage_body: Data is stored with the cloud services Supabase (Singapore) and Cloudflare.
privacy_rights_body: You may ask to access, correct or delete your data by contacting AQRJ. Contact details will be added before launch.
